QQQ.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance (unofficial provider client)

interpretation.text:
QQQ’s 252-observation DFA H is 0.520 on 2026-11-06, slightly above the ideal independent, finite-variance returns reference of 0.5. R²=0.980 measures fit quality only across supplied scales, 8–63. H rose 0.0135 over one observation and 0.0445 over five. It sits 2.70 standard deviations above its prior-only 30-estimate baseline; overlapping windows make this no significance test.

Hill alpha is 3.300 over 1,000 observations, using k=100 absolute returns above x_min=0.019899 absolute log-return units. Conditional on a suitable tail model, lower alpha suggests heavier fitted tails; higher suggests thinner tails. Alternative 5%/15% cutoffs yield 3.591/3.080: sensitivity, not a confidence interval.

From 2026-11-03 to 2026-11-06, H rose from 0.484 to 0.520. Alpha went from 3.309 through 3.198 on November 5 to 3.300. These are uncertain descriptive estimates, not a crash forecast.
